_help.how: Copy this file to tmai_settings.json (start_training.bat does it for you), edit the values below, save, then double-click start_training.bat. Lines starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
_help.map_name: The map's name as the game shows it, e.g. Test1. Demo laps and the best replay are found by this name.
_help.run_name: Folder under runs\ for this training. Leave empty to use the map name, so each map keeps its own run.
_help.map_has_checkpoints: true if the map has checkpoints. Only used when restart_button is auto.
_help.restart_button: Gamepad button that restarts the attempt: auto, B, BACK, START, X, Y, A, LB, RB or a DPAD_ direction. auto = BACK (bind Give up to View/Back in Settings > Controls) on maps with checkpoints, B on maps without.
_help.menu_button: Button that picks Improve on the end-of-race menu after a personal best. Usually A.
_help.update_code: true = git pull and reinstall the Python package before starting.
_help.reinstall_plugin: true = copy the TMAI Telemetry and TMAI Ghost plugins into Openplanet before starting (then reload them in game with F3).
_help.wait_for_game: true = list the in-game checks and wait for Enter before driving.
_help.record_demo_if_missing: true = if this map has no demo laps yet, record them first (you drive).
_help.demo_laps: How many laps to record when there are no demo laps yet.
_help.start_dashboard: true = start the dashboard in its own window.
_help.open_browser: true = open the dashboard in your browser.
_help.fresh_start: true = ignore the last checkpoint and start this run over. Put it back to false afterwards.
_help.train_minutes: Stop by itself after this many minutes, or null to train until you stop it.
_help.capture_backend: window (works behind other windows) or screen (game must be visible and on top).
_help.extra_settings: Any other setting from configs/default.yaml, e.g. {"train.batch_size": 128, "env.episode_timeout_s": 90}.
